inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped query uses COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE ...) to require that every row in each entity group satisfies a condition, with correlated per-group MIN and MAX scalar subqueries.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a reviewer qualification update. Every score for a reviewer must be strictly between the minimum and maximum score of its batch; a derived grouped candidate set drives an UPDATE through an IN subquery. The source schema, identifiers, data, and domain are newly authored.

fixture_notes: Reviewer 101 has only interior scores and is qualified. Reviewer 102 has one batch maximum, reviewer 103 has a single-score batch where minimum equals maximum, and reviewer 104 has only batch extrema; those reviewers remain unqualified.
determinism_notes: All scores and batch IDs are fixed and non-NULL. The candidate grouping and final reviewer ordering are deterministic; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE reviewer_status (reviewer_id INT PRIMARY KEY, reviewer_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, qualified TINYINT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE reviewer_scores (score_id INT PRIMARY KEY, reviewer_id INT NOT NULL, batch_id INT NOT NULL, score INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: UPDATE reviewer_status SET qualified = 1 WHERE reviewer_id IN (SELECT candidates.reviewer_id FROM (SELECT reviewer_id FROM reviewer_scores GROUP BY reviewer_id HAVING COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE WHEN score NOT IN ((SELECT MAX(score) FROM reviewer_scores bounds_max WHERE bounds_max.batch_id = reviewer_scores.batch_id), (SELECT MIN(score) FROM reviewer_scores bounds_min WHERE bounds_min.batch_id = reviewer_scores.batch_id)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) candidates)

checks.sql: SELECT reviewer_id, reviewer_name, qualified FROM reviewer_status ORDER BY reviewer_id

SELECT reviewer_id, COUNT(*) AS score_count, SUM(CASE WHEN score NOT IN ((SELECT MAX(score) FROM reviewer_scores bounds_max WHERE bounds_max.batch_id = reviewer_scores.batch_id), (SELECT MIN(score) FROM reviewer_scores bounds_min WHERE bounds_min.batch_id = reviewer_scores.batch_id)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS interior_count FROM reviewer_scores GROUP BY reviewer_id ORDER BY reviewer_id
